entities.summary: Kan'ami Kiyotsugu  was a Japanese Noh actor, author, and musician during the Muromachi period. Born Yūzaki Kiyotsugu  in Iga Province, Kan'ami also went by Miyomaru (観世丸) and Kanze Kiyotsugu . He is the father of the well-known playwright Zeami Motokiyo .
